div.head: EGu 5
div.ab: ⁊ gyf deaðscyldig man scriftspræce gyrne, ne him man næfre.
⁊ gif deaþscyldig man scriftspræce gyrne, ne him man næfre ne wyrne.
Et si quis reus mortis confessionem desiderat (profiteri desideret sacerdoti), nunquam negetur ei.
⁊ gif deaþscyldig man scriftspræce gyrne, ne him man næfre ne wyrne.
And gif deaþscyldig man scriftspræce gyrne, ne him man næfre ne wyrne.
If a man condemned to death desires confession, it shall never be refused him.
And if someone sentenced to death desires confession, it shall never be denied to him.
Und wenn ein Todes schuldiger Mensch Beichte verlangt, verweigere man sie ihm niemals.
And if a man liable to death asks for confession, let it never be refused him.
